title: Robot Chassis Design Workshop
description: Learn the basics of robot chassis design, material selection, and mechanical structure. Participants will explore how to build a stable and efficient robot body through practical examples.

title: Mini Sumo Bot Build Camp
description: Explore the mechanical design and construction of mini sumo robots. Participants will learn about robot stability, chassis structure, and competition-ready design through team activities.

title: Python for Robotics Bootcamp
description: Learn Python programming fundamentals and discover how code controls robotic systems. This bootcamp introduces basic algorithms, sensor data processing, and simple robotics applications.

title: Intro to Computer Vision Seminar
description: Discover how computers interpret images and videos for robotic applications. Learn about object detection, image processing, and the role of computer vision in autonomous robots.

title: Line Follower Robot Workshop
description: Build a line-following robot using sensors, electronic components, and a microcontroller. Participants will learn sensor calibration, motor control, and basic embedded programming.

title: IoT Smart Home Project Showcase
description: Explore smart home projects built with sensors, microcontrollers, and IoT technologies. Club members demonstrate how connected devices can improve home automation and energy management.

title: Robotics Photography and Video Day
description: Learn how to capture robotics projects, workshops, and competitions through photography and video. Participants will practice visual storytelling and create engaging content for the club.

title: School Robotics Awareness Program
description: Introduce school students to robotics, basic engineering, and creative problem-solving. Club volunteers will demonstrate simple robots and encourage young learners to explore technology.
